fields.caption: you can't have cache-coherence bugs / if Frostbite deletes shared memory

narrative_summary: A smug blob treats Frostbite’s AI-designed interaction-net architecture as a foolproof way to delete cache coherence by deleting shared memory.
rationale: Candidate 2 turns a real Frostbite architectural detail into a clean, compact loophole joke: eliminate shared memory and cache-coherence bugs disappear with it. The Roll Safe template fits the smug fake-insight structure, and the technical premise gives it a sharper punchline than the more descriptive alternatives.
